files.name: motion-prompt-119.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Light leak" (ライトリーク), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #119

What it is: Red-orange glow as if light leaked onto the film
What the sample shows: From the right edge of the same landscape a band of leaked light comes in, pale yellow on the inside and red at the edge, swaying slowly.
Spec:
- Scene 3: a bust on the left (head centre x 140, y 82, radius 28 px) and hills, a house, trees and the sun (x 432, y 54, radius 15 px) on the right. 
- Shape: four tall ellipses centred 30 px outside the right edge (swaying ±6 px over the loop), vertical radius 1.1× the frame height
- Horizontal radius and colour: 250 px #FFD089 at 35%, 170 px #FF9A3D at 40%, 95 px #FF5A3A at 45%, 45 px #FF3B30 at 50% (each grows from 0 to this radius)
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: For nostalgic, summery, accidental-looking memories.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/119.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
